releases.name: LinBox Bionic Box64 v0.4.4 (aarch64)
releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

- bionic ELF（PT_INTERP=/system/bin/linker64），与 rootfs 内
  wine / mesa / pulseaudio 等二进制同链同形态；box64 本体零
  glibc 依赖
- 完整安装集（不再只有单个 box64 执行文件）：
  `usr/local/bin/box64` + `usr/bin/box64` PATH 入口链接
  + `usr/lib/box64-x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++_shared.so`
  （上游 ANDROID 模式配套，被仿真 x86_64 程序的 C++ 标准库）
  + `usr/etc/box64.box64rc`（系统级调优开关）
  + `usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/`（`ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`
  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64
  与 rootfs 内 glibc 二进制的运行层）
  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的
  glibc 运行库，box64 经 BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH 查找）
- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...
  自动就位），或 `linbox-container install-box64 <tar.gz|URL>`
- 安装后 linbox-container 自动探测 /usr/local/bin/box64
- 用途: 在 aarch64 设备上运行 x86_64 Wine（backend=box64）；
  v0.4.4 为 hangover-11.16 官方配套版本（错配可致 wineboot SEH 级联崩溃）
- 注意: 与完整 rootfs 包（build-bionic-rootfs）同源 —— rootfs 已内置
  同款 box64 与配套文件，单独升级时才需要本包

Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.5.0
releases.body:
A new look for both launchers and the touch controls, and phone vibration.

**New background art** on every launcher: a moonlit balcony over a violet night city.

**Android launcher, redesigned for a phone held sideways**
- A top bar with the title, the version and Follow; Report a bug and Settings on the right.
- Status chips for the game data, shader cache, controller, chip and temperature. Tap one for the details.
- One notice at a time (setup, update, game mode) instead of stacked cards.
- Under your right thumb: a 30 / 40 / 60 performance switch and a big START that stays on screen however short the display.
- The Settings panel fits the screen. New rows: **Phone vibration** and **Show frame rate**.

**Touch controls**: redrawn as dark glass in the launcher's colours, with white labels; a pressed button lights up gold.

**Phone vibration**: with no controller in use, the game's rumble now vibrates the phone itself, softer than full strength. With a controller in use, its own motors rumble as before. Turn it off under Settings > Phone vibration.

**Frame-rate counter**: now off by default on Android, as on desktop. Turn it on under Settings > Show frame rate.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.5
releases.body:
> **Follow the author on X: [@aoxzh](https://x.com/aoxzh)** for progress updates, previews and new releases.

## What's new

### Android: 1080p (docked) resolution
Phones always ran the game in handheld mode at 1280×720, and there was no way to change it. **Settings > Resolution** now offers:
- **Handheld · 720p**: the default, and the lighter of the two.
- **Docked · 1080p**: the game draws as it does on a TV, at up to 1600×900, shown at 1080p.

Docked mode is sharper but much heavier on the GPU, the battery and the heat. Try it on a strong phone. It takes effect the next time the game starts.

## Updating
- **From v0.4.4:** use **Update now** in the launcher (Android: then tap **SET UP** again).
- **From an older version:** desktop, unpack over the old install and choose **Rebuild**; Android, install the APK over the old app.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.4
releases.body:
> **Follow the author on X: [@aoxzh](https://x.com/aoxzh)** for progress updates, previews and new releases.

## What's new

### One-click updates
- **Windows / Linux / Steam Deck:** when a newer release is out, the launcher shows **Update now** on the home screen and in its menu, so a controller can reach it. One click:
  1. Downloads the release.
  2. Checks it against the release's sha256.
  3. Replaces the program files.
  4. Restarts the launcher and rebuilds the game.

  Your settings, saves, game data and mods (everything under `private/`) stay.
- **Android:** **Update now** downloads the new APK inside the app and opens Android's installer. Android checks the signature before installing. Afterwards the launcher asks you to tap **SET UP** again; it continues from the last setup and only rebuilds what changed.
- Nothing is downloaded without that tap. **Settings > Check for updates** turns the check off.

### New icon
- New art for the app, the launchers, the shortcuts and the README.

## Updating to this version
- **Windows / Linux / Steam Deck:** unpack the release over the old one, then choose **Rebuild**. This is the last time you need to update by hand.

GTA Stories Recompiled 0.3.2

Fixes
- LCS: every weapon shot at the same spot in free aim (#6). Fixed in the app; your game library keeps working. Android and PC.

The intent is to port the project to pure SDL3 eventually, but in the meantime, this allows users the ability to test the new backend.

## What's Changed
* externals: Switch from SDL2 to SDL3 via sdl2-compat by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/315

Third Party Updates

releases.name: Borked3DS v2025.01.23
releases.body:
This release features many experimental/WIP Android improvements by @kleidis that you can test before they eventually get merged into [Azahar](https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar). It also brings up various third-party dependencies to their latest major versions, and includes some very minor bug fixes.

There is also [a beta release](https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/releases/tag/v2025.01.23-sdl-compat) that is the same as this one except that it incorporates the use of SDL3 via the SDL2 compatability layer. The intent is to port this project over to pure SDL3 eventually, but the compatability layer approach allows people to play around with things while waiting for the porting to be completed. This also gives this project a fallback in case SDL2 stops being supported upstream but new functionality such as gamepad support for new game controllers continues to be updated on the SDL3 branch.

### What's Changed
* Android: Some minor fixes by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/293
* renderer_opengl: Enable a couple of optimizations by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/294

# FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE · Android 原生移植版 v1.1.0 发布说明

- **版本号**：`v1.1.0`（`versionCode=80`，`org.ffrs.gamewindow`）
- **通用安装包**：`FFRS-1.1.0-universal.apk`（`arm64-v8a`，全平台通用）

---

## 本版本主要更新

### 1. 通用性能优化（骁龙 / 天玑全平台适用）
- **描述符与同步热路径优化**：新增图形 `PushMemo` 负载缓存、`PushMemoTexel` 原地刷新与 `SlotSets` 惰性分配，大幅降低重复描述符构建开销；扩大 `push_memo_map` 容量上限至 `32768`，避免复杂大场景频繁整表清空。
- **瞬态着色器自适应旁路**：新增 `PushMemoShaderState` 机制，自动识别连续未命中的瞬态着色器并临时旁路查表，减少无效哈希计算。
- **屏障与状态查询精简**：收窄 `texel` 与 `compute_barrier()` 管线屏障，合并 `pending_view()` 单趟重叠检查，缓存 `VkFormatProperties3` 并跳过只读纹理的重复 `prepare_read`。
- **洞窟场景闪烁修复**：修复洞窟路段左右移动时偶发的右半屏隔帧闪烁问题，保持全场景画面完整稳定输出。

### 2. 完整内置功能
- **画质与帧率设置**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **画质与帧率**）：
  - **帧率上限**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 30 FPS / 40 FPS / 60 FPS`，调节后实时生效，无需重启。
  - **画面输出档位**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 720p 输出 / 1080p 输出`，保存并重开游戏后生效。
- **内置中文金手指**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **金手指**，勾选保存并重启生效）：
  - 移动速度 2 倍
  - 不遇敌（按住 R3 临时恢复正常）
  - 战斗掉落率 100%
  - 战斗经验值 2 倍
  - 战斗金币 2 倍
  - 角色存档修改

### 3. 虚拟手柄默认布局优化
- 缩小肩键（`L1/L2/R1/R2`）与功能键（`- / +`）尺寸，将肩键下移至左右中侧边缘，避免遮挡左上角帧率/任务信息与右上角小地图。
- 对称对齐左右摇杆、`L3/R3`、十字键与 `A/B/X/Y` 菱形按键间距，默认布局更紧凑清晰（仍支持在「编辑按键布局」中自由微调或重置）。

---

## 安装与使用提示
- 请确保设备存储根目录已放置合法导出的游戏数据目录 `/sdcard/FFRS`。

# Let's Go Launcher 0.3

This is the third release of Let's Go Launcher. It brings the game from barely playable on Mali to a real frame rate on weak devices, and fixes the boot failure that stopped the game from opening on some phones.

## Measured performance (Galaxy S20+, Mali-G77, heavy scene)

- **~13.6 fps → 16–20 fps, average ~17.6, peak 20.1** (measured over a 73-second session in the heavy scene; the previous build averaged ~13.6 fps there)
- The game is now GPU-bound (~96% GPU busy, ~23% CPU) — the CPU is no longer the wall
- With a warm pipeline cache, indoor battles reached 23–26 fps
- No crashes in the test session

## What's new in 0.3

- **Boots where it didn't before** — the guest memory base moved from 0x60 to 0x50 (v0132), fixing the launch failure on devices where that range is occupied
- **Log viewer works on HarmonyOS** — when logcat returns nothing, "Ver log" now reads the log file the runtime writes (fix for issue #15)

releases.name: FEX Release FEX-2611
releases.body:
# Read the blog post at [FEX-Emu's Site!](https://fex-emu.com/FEX-2611/)
You know the drill, it's been around a month so that means we have a new release landing. A smattering of changes all over the codebase this time.
Let's see what's interesting!

## CPU core index through TPIDRRO_EL0
This is a fun feature that has come about primarily because Windows on ARM mandates this feature. The [TPIDRRO_EL0](https://support.arm.com/documentation/ddi0601/2026-09/AArch64-Registers/TPIDRRO-EL0--EL0-Read-Only-Software-Thread-ID-Register?lang=en) register
is an ARM system register that is readable by userspace that the kernel can set to whatever 64-bit value it wants. In particular under Windows it is
part of their [ABI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/build/arm64-windows-abi-conventions?view=msvc-170#system-registers) that this register must
contain the current CPU core index once read. This gives ARM64/ARM64ec applications a really quick way to read what core it is executing on. This is

releases.name: Xenoblade DE port v0.16.1
releases.body:
## Runtime update (no visible change in this port)

This release carries a fix from the Catherine port's runtime, which both ports share.

Some games bind a block of shader constants that is shorter than what their shader actually reads. On the console the bytes just past the block are the next bytes of the game's own structure; the port was filling them with zeros. It now copies them from the game's memory up to the next 16-byte boundary and keeps zeros beyond that.

**Nothing changes in Xenoblade: its G-buffer vertex shader reads up to 368 bytes with 256 bound, and 256 is already a multiple of 16, so it keeps getting zeros — exactly as before.** Re-verified on the Flip 2 with a copy of the save: characters whole (Shulk with the Monado, the party), 30.1 fps in battle, saves untouched.

## En español

Esta versión trae un arreglo del runtime que comparte con el port de Catherine.

releases.name: Xenoblade DE port v0.16.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

## Save report and update notices

Two new rows in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge of the screen):

- **Save report** writes a folder `reports/<date>/` into your game folder: the log, a screenshot of the moment you opened the panel, the frame times of the last seconds and basic device information (model, Android version, memory). **Nothing is sent anywhere.** If something looks wrong, open an [issue](https://github.com/IamWilmar/xenoblade-recomp/issues) and attach those files (have a look first: the log contains the names of your folders).
- **Update notices** (on by default): about eight seconds after the game starts, the app asks GitHub's public API which release is the latest. It is a single request, without an account, and nothing about you or your game is sent. If there is a newer version, a banner says so and *Get vX.Y.Z* opens its page. Switch it off in the panel (or create an empty file `sin_avisos_version` in the game folder) and the app makes no network request at all.
- Because of the update notices the app now has Android's **Internet** permission. It is used for that request only.

releases.name: v0.14.0
releases.body:
## Sharper 3D

- **The 3D image is upscaled with AMD FSR 1 before the game adds its interface.** The game draws its 3D at a dynamic resolution (for example 704×416 in handheld mode) and stretched it to its 720p window with a simple filter; on the Flip 2 that 720p image was then stretched again to the 1080p screen. Now FSR rebuilds the 3D at 720p first, and the step to 1080p sharpens instead of only stretching. The interface is untouched. The difference is largest in TV mode, where the 3D is narrowest.
- It costs about 2.8 ms of GPU per frame and turns itself off for a moment when a heavy scene would not fit in the 30 fps frame. Measured on the Flip 2 in the open field: 30 fps in handheld and TV mode.
- To get the previous image, create an empty file named `sin_fsr_escena` in the game's data folder (it takes effect while the game runs).

# WWE '12 PC 1.5.0 "Small PCs"

This version is about PCs with few or slow CPU cores: a start-up freeze is fixed, parts of the game run faster, and there is a new FPS counter. It also fixes two Universe problems.

## Fixes

- **Fixed a rare freeze on "NOW LOADING" at start-up** on PCs with few or slow CPU cores (a race between the game's sound-bank loading threads). The game could stay on the first loading screen forever. On a test PC limited to 2 slow cores it froze in 2 starts out of 10 before the fix and never in 10 starts after it (#69, #74: if your freeze has another cause, tell us). 
- **No more loading-screen speed-up on PCs with fewer than 8 usable threads**, where it could lock the game at its frame barrier.
- **Universe: SmackDown (and other weekly shows) no longer end up with only 0-1 match** when their roster is small: a match that would be dropped because everyone is resting now takes a rested Superstar instead.

releases.name: WWE '12 PC 1.4.1
releases.body:
# WWE '12 PC 1.4.1

A small update after 1.4.0: a Royal Rumble crash fixed, and belt modding in the Mod Maker.

## Fixes

- **Royal Rumble crash (#79):** in 1.4.0, the animations added for the I QUIT match were loaded in **every** match. The Royal Rumble, which loads the most wrestlers, could run out of room in the game's animation memory and crash, or leave wrestlers frozen and entrants stuck behind the ramp. They are now only added in an **I QUIT** match or a **Special Guest Referee** match; every other match is the original game again. I QUIT and the special referee work as before.

releases.body:
**WWE '12 PC v1.3.0 — "Speed and fixes"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Faster
- **Loading screens shorter** (a match loads in about 1.5 s instead of 4 s, the end of the entrances in about 1.9 s instead of 4.5 s). `wwe12_fast_loading = false` brings the old behaviour back.
- **Faster start-up** on PCs with 8 or more logical processors: the title screen comes after about 5-7 s instead of 15 s. On smaller processors the normal start-up is kept (`wwe12_fast_boot_min_threads`).
- **Sharper picture** when the game is drawn at 720p on a bigger screen (`svr_upscale_sharpness`, 0 turns it off).
- **Adaptive V-sync**: a late frame is shown at once instead of waiting a whole refresh (`svr_adaptive_vsync`).
- **Performance test** in the launcher (button *Performance test*): it plays a recorded 1-on-1 match with entrances once and tells you if your PC is fine, limited by the processor or by the graphics card. Nothing is changed without your agreement.

### Frame rate

**WWE '12 PC v1.2.0 — "Moveset update"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Match-start stutter (and a short freeze) on integrated graphics (Intel...)**: the game's reads of the picture back from the graphics card are now grouped at the end of the frame (about 10 times less waiting at the start of a match). `svr_readback_defer_streak = false` goes back to 1.1.
- **Less work for the processor every frame** (helps small PCs, issue #53): shader constants are reused like on Android (`svr_reuse_constant_blocks`) and the check of 3D models is lighter (`svr_geometry_sample_min`, 32768 brings the 1.1 behaviour back).
- **Crash at start with file names that have accents or other characters** (for example a song called "Café.mp3" or a mod folder with Japanese letters in a mod): names are now read as UTF-8 everywhere in the game, the launcher and the Mod Maker, and a mod with an unreadable name is skipped instead of closing the game.

# WWE '12 PC 1.5.0 "Small PCs"

This version is about PCs with few or slow CPU cores: a start-up freeze is fixed, parts of the game run faster, and there is a new FPS counter. It also fixes two Universe problems.

## Fixes

- **Fixed a rare freeze on "NOW LOADING" at start-up** on PCs with few or slow CPU cores (a race between the game's sound-bank loading threads). The game could stay on the first loading screen forever. On a test PC limited to 2 slow cores it froze in 2 starts out of 10 before the fix and never in 10 starts after it (#69, #74: if your freeze has another cause, tell us).

releases.body:
**Headlight beams in both games, and the first Android beta.** At night your car finally lights up the road ahead and we're releasing the Android version for further testing.

## Features

- **Headlight beams.** Turning your lights on at night now throws a beam of light onto the road ahead, as on the original Xbox: it brightens the street, cars and walls it reaches and stops where it meets them ([#10](https://github.com/laureladastra/mcdub3-nx/issues/10), thanks for the report). Before, the lights worked in the game but no beam was drawn. Other emulators (i.e. xemu → https://github.com/xemu-project/xemu/issues/996) show a solid white shape instead. The game builds the beam in a small hidden picture using two tricks of the Xbox's graphics chip that the port did not reproduce yet: it reuses a picture as a depth map, and it counts the beam's layers with a special blending mode that works with negative numbers. Both are emulated now. Tested in the DUB Edition and the Remix. The WHITE button flashes your high beams while you hold it. The main headlights are on by themselves at night.

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v1.0.0
releases.body:
**Version 1.0 for both games on the Nintendo Switch.** This release removes the last annoyances: races that felt slow when the frame rate dipped, random zoom-in or out during loading screens, and vertical lines during upscaling.

### Features

- **Races keep their real speed.** The original game moves the race forward by a fixed step every frame, which was fine on the Xbox, where it runs on a fixed 30 FPS. On the Switch, in rain, with nitrous or in the busiest streets, the frame rate can dip and the whole race then went into slow motion. The race now proceeds by the time that really passed. Racing in the rain and with nitrous feels much steadier.
- **No more random zooms during loading screens.** Menus and loading screens are drawn for 4:3 TVs, with black strips at the sides, and the port enlarges them to fill your 16:9 screen. When something briefly reached those strips (the circle animation on loading screens for example), the picture behind it jumped in size for a brief moment. The size stays put now.

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v0.5.0
releases.body:
**A big speed update for both games on the Switch.** Races, especially in the rain, now run close to the game's own top speed of 30 FPS most of the time. Freezes during races are minimised.

### Features

- Measured in rain races on the Switch (at the default 1x picture size):

  |                                    | v0.4.0                 | v0.5.0   |
  | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------- | -------- |
  | Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition       | 23 frames per second   | **28.5** |
  | Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix | 20.5 frames per second | **27.5** |

  The game itself never runs faster than 30, as on the original Xbox, so most of the time you are now at or near full speed.
- **No more half-second freezes in races.** The game stopped for about half a second now and then during a race, most often right after the start.
- **Sharper look for less effort (Remix).** The Remix's glow and blur effects are drawn at normal size even when you raise the picture size, which cost a lot of speed for something that is blurred anyway.

### Other changes

- Each game now has its own tuned graphics settings, so improving one game does not change the other.

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.1
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.1 — your settings stay put

A patch release. No new features: **23 defects** found and fixed across five rounds of multi-agent bug hunting, plus a hardware-validation pass on the published packages.

### Settings are saved again

On macOS and on every AppImage, NeoST runs from **read-only media**, so it stores its configuration in your user directory — but it never created that directory, and every setting was silently lost when you closed the emulator. **Five of the eight packages were affected.** Machine profile, video, audio and MIDI setup now survive a restart.

### Also fixed

- **The macOS disk image installs by drag and drop.** It shipped with the app alone, no `Applications` shortcut.
- **The web build ships its licences** (GPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, third-party notices), like every other package.
- **A save-state can no longer be reloaded under a different ROM.** The pairing relied on two bytes of TOS version, which five localisations share, so resuming under the wrong ROM froze the CPU without a word. The state format is now **v19**; v18 and older are refused explicitly, with a message that says why.

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 18.4.7
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.7** - *Оптимизация запуска и логов по результатам тестирования игр, а также единый 12-язычный стандарт окна обновлений для Windows и Android*

---

## Русский

### Ключевые улучшения и оптимизации
- **Ускорение прямого запуска игр (`-g` / CLI)**: При прямом запуске игры из командной строки или ярлыка откладывается фоновое сканирование каталогов, предзагрузка TitleDB, фоновая проверка обновлений и стартовый опрос каталога STORM GAMES WORLD, благодаря чему CPU, диск и память сразу отдаются запуску игры.
- **Изоляция фонового сканера во время игры**: Периодический 45-секундный сканер STORM GAMES WORLD больше не запускается во время активной эмуляции.
- **Снижение нагрузки на логирование AOC (`Diablo III` и др.)**: Частые системные опросы `GetAddOnContentListChangedEvent` и `GetAddOnContentListChangedEventWithProcessId` переведены с `LOG_INFO` на `LOG_DEBUG`, что убирает лишнюю блокировку логера в играх с активным опросом DLC.

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 18.4.6
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.6** - *Сборка с исправлением смены шрифта интерфейса, позиционированием окна STORM GAMES WORLD, живым переключением 3X (6K) и улучшениями ядра и рендера*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения
- 🌟 **Шрифт интерфейса и стабильность настроек**: Выбор шрифта обновляет весь интерфейс Qt целиком при многократном переключении без перезапуска; устранено обрезание кнопок в шапке настроек и исправлен вылет при повторном открытии диалога настроек (Use-After-Free в коллбэке `ConfigureDialog`).
- 🌟 **Окно STORM GAMES WORLD**: Диалог автоматически центрируется относительно главного окна эмулятора с ровными отступами по 100px сверху, снизу, слева и справа (`width - 200px`, `height - 200px`).
- 🌟 **Живое переключение 3X (6K) без зависаний**: Переработан синхронный сброс и перестройка текстур/пайплайнов на GPU-потоке (`ApplyPendingResolutionChange`, `RequestResolutionUpdate`), устраняющие фриз при смене масштаба во время игры.
- 🌟 **Графика, стабильность и ядро**: Обновлены профили глубины `NEEDS_D24` для серии Xenoblade (`XC1 DE`, `XC3`), уточнён `ConvertBorderColor` для сэмплеров карт теней, добавлена безопасная очистка буферов и улучшен обработчик `STx_mult_2` в NCE.

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 18.4.5
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.5** - *Исправление зависания Diablo III, мгновенное закрытие сервисов (Xenoblade Chronicles 3), плавный фреймпейсинг на ПК через Mailbox VSync, адаптивный пропуск кадров и синхронизация скриншотов*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения
- 🌟 **Diablo III: Eternal Collection и модальные апплеты**: Устранено зависание ядра на 43.47 с и блокировка закрытия окна (`WM_CLOSE`) из-за модального окна выбора контроллера.
- 🌟 **Мгновенное завершение эмуляции (Xenoblade Chronicles 3 и др.)**: Устранены многосекундные задержки `CloseServices` (`hid`, `arp:r`, `psc:c`) - время закрытия сокращено с 9.10 с до 1.91 с.
- 🌟 **Плавность на ПК (Desktop Mailbox VSync + адаптивный Frame Skip)**: Режим VSync по умолчанию для ПК переключен на `Mailbox` (Android сохраняет `Fifo`), а пропуск кадров срабатывает только при реальной очереди вывода (`present_queue >= 2`).
- 🌟 **30-FPS тайтлы и 4K рендер (Diablo II: R, Xenoblade DE / 3)**: Исправлен опрос неподтвержденного Vulkan-тика в swapchain, добавлена автоадаптация `DynamicPerformanceScaler` под нативную каденцию 30 FPS и защита профиля `Animal Well`.

> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.4** - *Крупное обновление графического ядра Vulkan и производительности: исправлены критические визуальные дефекты в Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition (сжатие в четверть экрана, полосы растяжения, чёрные лица, невидимые модели и мигающие прямоугольники), устранены пропажа/обрезка глифов и низкий FPS в Diablo II: Resurrected, внедрена комплексная оптимизация быстродействия, нагрева и расхода ОЗУ/VRAM, а также устранены зависания при выходе.*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения

- 🛠️ **[Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition и глобальное видеоядро Vulkan]**:
  - Исправлено «ослепление» конвейеров и деградация вьюпорта при смене масштаба разрешения на лету (`1X -> 2X`): новый метод `PipelineCache::HandleLiveResolutionChange()` сохраняет `graphics_key.state` (`viewport_swizzles`, состояние смешивания и вершинный ввод), принудительно помечает грязными флаги `Shaders`, `VertexInput`, `ViewportSwizzles` и `Blending` на всех активных каналах и дедуплицирует `vulkan.bin`.

Faster starts with mods installed, plus housekeeping for the releases themselves. Everything from [0.4.9](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.9) is included.

## Mods

- **Mods no longer slow down every start.** The port used to read every file of every mod in `mods` at each start to check it, which took seconds with big mods. It now remembers those checks and only reads a file again when its size or date changes. The first start after installing or updating a mod takes as long as before; the next ones skip that work.

## Android

- The APK's internal version number jumps from 39 to 4010. It still installs over the old one; nothing to do on your side.

## Install / update

Windows: download `gow2-recomp-0.4.10-win64.zip` and copy the **contents** of its `gow2-recomp-0.4.10-win64` folder into your game folder. Your `gow2.toml` and saves are kept.

releases.name: v0.4.9
releases.body:
Achievement names in Cyrillic, Korean and Chinese, a saving message that no longer mentions a console, better Mali detection on Android, Esc going back in menus, and the first community contributions, all from optimistic-blip. Everything from [0.4.8](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.8) is included.

## Fixes

- **Achievement names in every language (#54).** The achievement pop-up and the achievement list (F7) are drawn by the port with a small Latin-only font, so Russian, Polish, Czech, Hungarian, Korean and Chinese names showed up as `?????`. That font now gets Cyrillic and the Central European letters from a system font (Segoe UI on Windows, Roboto on Android), plus Korean or Traditional Chinese glyphs when the game runs in one of those languages.
- **"Please don't turn off your PC" (#64).** The checkpoint message said "console". It now says PC in all 12 languages, and "device" on Android. The text is changed at run time like the port's other text edits; the game folder is not touched. The idea, and a tool for changing the file itself, came from optimistic-blip.

releases.name: v0.4.8
releases.body:
Co-op settings no longer have to match between friends, players 3 and up get their own Centaur in the tank chapter, and the native renderer stops smearing textures on AMD cards. Everything from [0.4.7](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.7) is included.

## Co-op

- **The host's settings apply to everyone in that campaign.** Before, a friend whose co-op settings differed from the host's (player count, extra players ending the game, and so on) did not see the campaign at all. Now only the release has to match: friends see the host's campaign whatever their own `gow2_coop_players` and co-op options say, and the host's settings decide how that campaign plays. Campaigns from a different release still stay hidden, and since 0.4.8 that check covers two-player games too.
- **One Centaur per player in the tank chapter.** When Marcus drives the Centaur, every player 3 and up gets a tank of their own next to him instead of hanging off his. If someone leaves their tank, dies, or falls too far behind, they get a new one next to Marcus; the extra tanks go away when the tank section ends. `gow2_coop_tanks = false` turns it off.

releases.name: v0.4.7
releases.body:
Phones get new defaults that run smoother and cooler, voices on Android should come through again, and every platform gets a Render scale option. Everything from [0.4.6](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.6) is included.

## Android

- **Frame rate unlocked with a 45 fps limit, by default.** Uncapped, the phone's GPU runs at full load until the phone lowers its clock as it heats up; the limit keeps headroom. The limit drops to the nearest rate that divides your screen's refresh, so every frame lasts the same: 40 fps on a 120 Hz screen (Galaxy S24/S25), 45 at 90 Hz, 30 at 60 Hz. On an S25 Ultra frame times went from a 25/25/16.7 ms mix to an even 25 ms. You can still pick 30, 60 or no limit in Device Options > Display > Frame rate limit.
- **Render scale 75 % by default.** The 3D scene is drawn at 75 % and scaled up to the screen; on an S25 Ultra that is 14 % less GPU work per frame, with a slightly softer picture. Graphics > Render scale goes back to 100 %.
- **Snapdragon GSR for the final upscale by default**, one pass instead of FSR 1's two.

releases.name: v0.4.6
releases.body:
Insane can now be picked from the start. Everything from [0.4.5](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.5) is included; if you have not read its notes, they cover the Riftworm fix for Vulkan, GPU detection on Linux and Proton, and the co-op go-to-player-1 key.

## Every platform

- **Insane without finishing the campaign first.** The option from 0.4.5, now named **All chapters and Insane unlocked** (PC Options > Saves, on by default), also enables the Insane button in the difficulty menu, in solo Campaign and in the co-op lobby. Before, the game greyed it out until the campaign had been finished once. As with chapters, only the menu check changes: your saved progress and the Extras list of unlockables are not touched.

## Known, still open

- Lighting that looks pixelated on Linux with presets above Low, and black textures on Low on Windows (both on a Legion Go): we could not reproduce them on our PC. A screenshot and the `logs/gow2_*.log` of the run, with the chapter, help a lot.

releases.name: shadps4 v0.18.0 - codename UltraPersona
releases.body:
shadPS4 v0.18.0 "UltraPersona"

Hello there, it hasn't been a while, has it? While not much time has passed since our last stable release, we are here again with a brand new one. The main reason for this release is broken shadNet authorization in certain cases on the 0.17.0 release, but we have some more interesting new features as well.

Firstly, after some fixes, AvPlayer can now be loaded as LLE, meaning that you need the `libSceAvPlayer.sprx` (and `libSceAvPlayerStreaming.sprx`) module(s), which makes broken videos in a few games now work properly.

The above change was enabled by calling `sceLibcInternalMemoryMutexEnable` in LLE LibcInternal at boot, found by [@liuk7071](https://github.com/liuk7071), the developer of ChonkyStation4, another PS4 emulator.

A kernel event flag rewrite has also fixed Shadow of the Colossus often hanging on boot, and the game now consistently gets to menus.

Builds your own Android APK of the PC version from your own copy of Mirror's Edge from GOG. Other releases of the game do not work.

**New in 0.3.3: much faster.**

releases.name: NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP
releases.body:
# NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP

Smaller archives, flexible packaging, and more control over your game collection. Version 4.0 introduces **NUP Tools**, alongside the existing NSP builder.

### Package more. Store less.

- **Create compressed NUP archives** from extracted game folders, with base games, updates and DLC together in one file.
- **Choose your balance:** Fast for quicker compression, Balanced for everyday use, or Smaller for stronger compression. Incompressible files are stored raw automatically.
- **Keep what you need:** select Base, Updates and DLC independently. Choices appear after inspection, only for content present in your source. Latest-snapshot mode merges the newest selected update with the selected base, retains required base-only files, and leaves superseded versions behind. Turn it off to keep separate base/update records.
- **Avoid duplicate storage:** identical file contents can share the same space inside an archive.
- **Stay compatible:** leave files larger than 256 MiB uncompressed to reduce temporary decompression work in supported emulators.

### Convert, extract and check

- **NSP → NUP:** compress plaintext NSPs created by NSP Box.

releases.name: NSP Box 3.1.0
releases.body:
# NSP Box 3.1.0

- **Selevet support:** the emulator patcher now supports Selevet Eglantine performance build 4, including both normal and 30 FPS Windows downloads.
- **Future-build matching:** minor Selevet updates can be recognized when the reviewed loader and metadata-reader fingerprints still match. Unverified matches are labeled experimental; changed or ambiguous hooks are refused.
- **Settings preserved:** adding or removing the metadata patch keeps `nx2_switches.txt` and the existing 30 FPS setting unchanged. Exact original executable backups remain available for removal.
- **Supported-build list:** added Selevet and adjusted the patch dialog so its full compatibility list remains visible.
- **Validation:** both Selevet downloads passed byte-exact patch removal, isolated native hook checks and real startup timing comparisons. Patched startup without a companion matched the external-NPDM path at 31.25 MHz. These checks do not establish gameplay compatibility or FPS gains.

- **New branding:** NSP Box, with redesigned icons and a new app logo.
- **Smoother UI:** subtle animated background, fluid transitions, and improved spacing.

- **Dedicated DLC tab:** create separate DLC NSPs for compatible emulators. Thanks [@ryzendew](https://github.com/ryzendew) for requesting separate packages in [#1](https://github.com/smarkyie/switch2-game-packager/issues/1).

**Experimental build — limited real-world testing.** Emulator and DLC compatibility varies. Supported patched emulators can load packages without an external `main.npdm`.

releases.name: Switch 2 Game Packager 2.0.0
releases.body:
# Switch 2 Game Packager 2.0.0

- **New Emulator patch panel:** select a Windows x64 emulator folder, check compatibility, add the patch and remove it later. Eglantine build 96 standard/PGO and PokeDinner 2.0.0 GUI/CLI profiles are recognized; matching future builds and forks can be tried experimentally without a new menu entry.
- **No separate `main.npdm` needed after patching:** compatible emulators read Switch 2 metadata already embedded inside this packager's plaintext XCI/NSP. Restart the emulator after applying the patch. Existing packages do not need rebuilding, and the packager need not remain open while playing.
- To create only a single XCI/NSP, uncheck **Create package folder**. The option remains on by default for unpatched emulators; without the patch, retain each game's exact external companion in its own folder. Selecting 12 GiB alone can still use incorrect timing and reduce performance.

releases.name: Switch 2 Game Packager 1.4.4
releases.body:
# Switch 2 Game Packager 1.4.4

- Add the reported performance drop without an external `main.npdm` to the startup caution, Notes & compatibility, README and release notes.

Portable Windows x64 build. Extract the complete Windows ZIP and run `Switch2-XCI-Packager.exe`. Source, licenses and build notes are included. No game data, artwork, firmware or retail keys are included.

**Caution — experimental:** set emulator memory to **12 GiB** before testing Switch 2 packages. Booting without an external companion was reported in PokeDinner 2.0.0 with this setting; other games/builds may differ. The app does not change emulator memory settings. Verification does not guarantee booting or gameplay.

SDL Renderer has been the backbone of graphics on Ymir... until now. Ymir now supports Direct3D 12 and Metal (with Vulkan to come in the future), which will enable implementation of shaders and resolution scaling down the line. Direct3D 12 also supports hardware-accelerated VDP rendering, offloading heavy graphics computations to your GPU for a significant performance boost with no accuracy compromises -- it's as accurate as the software renderer, save for undiscovered bugs. Other graphics backends will eventually support acceleration as well, hang tight!

The Virtua Gun has been promoted to a stable feature after numerous bug fixes and accuracy improvements that made it work flawlessly with most supported games. Known issues are listed in #787: only one game doesn't register shots, and three don't recognize reloads consistently.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.3-dev
releases.body:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.2.1-dev.

## Saves and stability

- Save files are written to a temporary file, validated, synchronized and atomically committed after the last handle closes. Write, sync and rename errors reach the game; failed temporary files are retained for possible recovery.
- Existing saves are validated before enumeration. Damaged files are omitted and quarantined under `SaveGames/damaged/`, fixing the main-menu crash path caused by an interrupted save. Checks cover headers, PNG thumbnails, metadata and zlib packages. This does not repair damaged save data.
- Added a workaround for device loss in high-quality bloom passes on Adreno 650 with the bundled Turnip driver reporting Vulkan API 1.3.335.

## Performance and rendering

- Optimized static index buffers, occlusion query batching, query reset and nonblocking result reads, and deferred offscreen clears on PanVK / Mali-G76 MC4. Automatic enablement is restricted to the measured GPU model.
- Updated bundled PanVK with deferred occlusion availability for Bifrost v7, command batch cleanup fixes and allocation error handling.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.2.1-dev
releases.body:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.2-dev:

## Changes and fixes

- Added crash reports with a copy-to-clipboard button. Reports are saved under `BioShock/crashes` and include the game log, build information and available native crash details. Crash monitoring can be disabled in the launcher.
- Fixed a buffer overflow when taking research-camera photos. Vulkan and OpenGL ES now respect the source and destination regions and resize the captured image to 256 x 256.
- Added movement-stick settings for the dead zone, visibility and fixed position.
- Added a slide-out weapon and plasmid inventory bar for the Port touch layout. Its **Weapon selection: On/Off** toggle is on **Input and prompts**. Weapon swipes now use a larger threshold and a rate limit for more controlled selection.
- Made the map and journal use interfaces that support both touch and gamepad input.
- Added launcher cleanup options for unused installation files and rebuildable caches. Limited diagnostic log growth and removed stale shader cache entries.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.2-dev
releases.body:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.1.1-dev:

## Performance and rendering

- Moved Vulkan pipeline and OpenGL ES program warm-up to low-priority background workers, with a larger seed recorded across all 15 levels. Cached results are reused on later starts.
- Reduced loading stalls through fairer thread handoffs, background logging and memory cleanup, texture read-ahead, and caching repeated missing-file checks.
- Removed redundant Vulkan buffer bindings and OpenGL ES state changes. Fixed compressed-texture uploads and preserved the aspect ratio when changing render resolution.
- Fixed first-person weapon and arm framing on wide screens while preserving world FOV, weapon FOV, and zoom settings.
- Updated bundled PanVK; compatible Mali devices can now use it on Android 11 or later. Added an Adreno 618 workaround for GPU loss with bundled Turnip.
- Renderer startup failures and device/context loss now return to the launcher with a reason and an offer to select another renderer.
- ADPF is now off by default.

## Controls and interface

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.1.1-dev
releases.body:
Second development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic.

## Controls and interface

- Added iPhone and iPad touch layouts alongside the port layout and a hidden-controls mode. The iOS layouts use 52 original sprites, including eight weapon icons and 22 plasmid icons. They show the equipped weapon and plasmid, the active slot, crouch or stand state, and the alternate reload icon in plasmid mode.
- Added a 50–200% iOS control scale and context-sensitive Hack, Rescue, and Harvest buttons. Control groups scale together and the left group accounts for the health and ammo HUD. Map and Pause activate on release over the same button.
- Kept movement and camera gestures available with the overlay hidden. Fixed absolute touch coordinates at screen edges and input recovery after graphics changes or a stalled input event.
- Added phone vibration for in-game rumble and touch feedback, with an on/off switch and strength adjustment in 25% steps.
- Added optional touch aim assist using BioShock's controller aim system. Each touch sample is consumed once, and direct touch look remains available when the game's aim properties are unavailable.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.1-dev
releases.body:
First development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. The port uses ahead-of-time recompilation of the original Windows x86 code.

## Features

- OpenGL ES 3.2 and Vulkan rendering, with bundled Turnip and PanVK options for compatible GPUs.
- Touch controls, gamepad input, and configurable controls.
- Launcher with folder and ZIP game-data import, renderer selection, optional texture conversion, and update checks.

## Requirements and installation

- An ARM64 Android device running Android 8.0 or later. OpenGL ES 3.2 is the default renderer. See the repository README for Vulkan and driver requirements.
- Your own installation of **BioShock Classic for Windows, patch 1.1, GOG build 127339**. The original game files are required separately.
- Sideload the APK. Copy your Classic game folder to the device with its `Builds/` and `Content/` directories, then select that folder under **Game data** in the launcher and press **Play**.

## Known limitations

Device, driver, and full-campaign testing is limited in this development release.

## Pocket-Hollow v1.4

First off, huge apologies to **Galaxy S26 Ultra** and **Xiaomi 17 Ultra** players on Recompa for taking so long to get this out — turned out to be a pretty simple fix once I dug into it. Appreciate everyone who reported it and stuck around!

### What's Fixed

* **Live Native FPS & Frametime Telemetry:** Fixed an issue where the on-screen telemetry pill (`FPS` and `ms`) remained stuck at `0`. Both counters now read live frame presentation timing directly from Aurora's graphics pipeline.

#### Pocket-Hollow v1.3.1 — Unofficial Fan-Made Android Port

*Sorry for so many updates—whenever I find something wrong, I fix it right away. It's just how I am!* 

An independent, fan-made Android ARM64 port and launcher built by a fan who wanted to play the game on Android handhelds and smartphones. **Pocket-Hollow is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the upstream Foxhollow project or its developers.** 

#### What’s New & Fixed

* **Lower Bluetooth & Wireless Controller Latency:** Bypassed Android's VSync input batching so wireless controller sticks and buttons register immediately, and removed the redundant V-Sync toggle from Graphics.
* **Automatic GPU & Driver Detection:** Detects the device's GPU on startup and automatically selects the optimal Vulkan driver and starting resolution scale across Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx/8xx), MediaTek Dimensity (Mali/Immortalis), Google Tensor, and Samsung Exynos devices.
* **Third-Person Camera Wall-Standoff Fix:** Added a 3-ray horizontal corner sweep against both map geometry and object hitboxes so rotating the camera 180° around walls, pillars, and doorways keeps it cleanly outside geometry.

## Pocket-Hollow v1.4

First off, huge apologies to **Galaxy S26 Ultra** and **Xiaomi 17 Ultra** players on Recompa for taking so long to get this out — turned out to be a pretty simple fix once I dug into it. Appreciate everyone who reported it and stuck around!

### What's Fixed
* **Galaxy S26 Ultra & Xiaomi 17 Ultra (Adreno 830 / 840):** Automatically defaults Adreno 8xx phones to **OpenGL ES 3.2** on first boot so they don't crash on Qualcomm's stock Vulkan driver. Every other GPU still defaults to **Vulkan** like normal.
* **Smarter Crash Recovery:** If Vulkan ever fails to boot on a device, Pocket-Hollow now automatically falls back to **OpenGL ES** on your next launch instead of getting stuck in a crash loop.
* **Android 16 File Permissions & Region Warning:** Fixed storage permission drops on One UI 8 / HyperOS 3, and added a clear popup if you accidentally pick a Europe (`GSAP01`) or Japan (`GSAJ01`) ISO instead of the required **USA (`GSAE01`)** ISO.

releases.body:
Kiwi360 0.2.0 is the first public release: faster with the bundled driver, image effects, recommended settings per game, and an updater, so later versions are offered in the app. Testers on 0.1.0: install this one by hand once.

**Faster**
- **Zero-copy guest memory now works with custom GPU drivers.** With Lemon-Ade (the default on Snapdragon) the game's memory used to fall back to staging copies; it is shared with the GPU again, as on the system driver.
- **Lemon-Ade v0.0.9 rebuilt** with 16 more Mesa changes, among them an Adreno 830 workaround and shader compiler and occlusion query fixes.

**More stable**
- **No more "app not responding" while playing:** the emulator no longer asks for the GPU's top priority, which could leave the app's own menus and touch input waiting behind the game.
- **Unsupported processors are explained instead of crashing:** Kiwi360 needs an ARMv8.2 CPU (Snapdragon 845 or later, or an equivalent MediaTek, Exynos or Tensor). On older Cortex-A53/A73 chips it now says so.
- **Better reports:** *Share logs* now includes the last 8 sessions (and every one from the last 48 hours), the crash reports, and which GPU driver each game uses.

**New**
